register: Computed: (A) a three-way split of the 123 cut-point computations by how their score list was obtained: PARAMETER_FREE_STRICT (published outlier bounds reproduced by the documented exclusion rules alone, outlier-bound check before_exact True, and no synthetic add score in the score list and no filled-in removal contract present in the documented score list), REMOVAL_ONLY (outlier bounds exact before filling and no add, but a filled-in removal, applied year-wide by build_jobs, drops >=1 real contract from the score list), FITTED (a synthetic add touches it or the outlier bounds needed filling); off-optimum, zero-gap and fewer-than-five-distinct-score counts per class per year on both stored gap tables, plus a fresh Ward-vs-exact-DP census on the pure documented-rules score list (filled-in layer stripped) at both vintages, exact SSQ comparison. (B) for each of the 60 criterion flip rows (34 in the dollar estimate), the measure cells actually moved (published star != criterion star) re-derived with the stored verify-suite machinery, each cell's computation class, the flip class, the check that the contract's own score in every moved measure is a real published score (synthetic adds are other, hypothetical contracts), and enrollment and |mid|-dollar sums of the dollar-estimate flips per class. Not computed / residual: none of this pins down CMS's actual score list. Even a PARAMETER_FREE_STRICT score list is a documented-rules reconstruction from the public files; equality of its two outlier-bound values with the published ones corroborates but does not prove score-list identity (distinct score lists can share quartiles). Configurations reported are the ones actually tested (two vintages x 123 computations), not all feasible score lists.
removal_scope_note: enclosure_census_docsonly.build_jobs and exact_gaps_docsonly.build_jobs drop every removal contract of a star year from every computation of that year in which it has a documented-score-list score (removals applied before adds; not scoped to the target that forced the removal). Hence REMOVAL_ONLY computations exist in 2024 (H0332, H1894) and 2025 (8 contracts); 2026 has no removals.

replay_vintage.register: Ward (SAS tie rule, IEEE double) vs exact DP optimum on the pure documented-rules score list (cost+d60r hypothesis; no synthetic adds, no filled-in removals) after the outlier trim; exact SSQ comparison (Fraction). For PARAMETER_FREE_STRICT computations this score list is the stored score list, so the row must reproduce the stored table (self-check). For REMOVAL_ONLY/FITTED it is a different, stated score list whose outlier bounds do not all match the published bounds.

criterion_vintage.register: Ward (SAS tie rule, IEEE double) vs exact DP optimum on the pure documented-rules score list (cost+d60r hypothesis; no synthetic adds, no filled-in removals) after the outlier trim; exact SSQ comparison (Fraction). For PARAMETER_FREE_STRICT computations this score list is the stored score list, so the row must reproduce the stored table (self-check). B_flip_provenance.register: Per flip row of runs/criterion_census.json (60 rows; 34 in the dollar estimate = qbp_priceable minus the demoted endpoint-conditional pair H1304-2024/H5273-2025): moved cells = measures where the criterion star (exact DP cut points at criterion vintage -> guardrail -> display rounding -> disaster hold-harmless, via criterion_verify_suite.delta_sets) differs from the published star, restricted to measures present in the contract's published star row (the aggregator's convention). Each cell's computation is classed by (A). Ratings re-derived with criterion_verify_suite.apply_and_rate and compared to the census row.
